guide: Open Start and type your imprint name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the largest store share you accept, the fee flag, the short-payment tolerance and the pay per 1,000 pages read.
Check Stores, Countries, Formats and Exchange rates. They hold the royalty share, the payment delay and the base rate of each store and currency (a typical range, check each store's current terms).
Enter the editions and titles once: the royalty per copy fills in from price, store share and the cost of a copy.
Each month enter the sales lines in the Sales ledger or only the monthly totals in Royalty by month and store and by format. Figures from stores are estimates until the payment arrives.
Enter the page reads in Page reads and the rate of each month in Royalty by currency and month; the income and the effect of the rate fill in by themselves.
Enter each store statement in Statements and each payment in Payments received: the expected date, the days overdue, the short amount and the fee check fill in.
Use the 18 tools to reconcile a month, rank the stores to write to, find short payments, plan cash, test a lost store and forecast the next 3 months.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
A first-time author with 1 to 3 books can use most sheets with a few rows; a small press can read the pen-name columns as author columns.
Read the Royalty KPI Dashboard and the charts every week. Replace the demo rows with your own when you are ready; a blank copy is shipped beside the sample copy.

listing.title: Author Royalty Tracker Excel Template: Sales Ledger, Earned vs Paid, Short Payments, Page Reads, Fees, Cash Forecast, Self-Publishing
listing.headline: See what each store earned, what it paid, and what is still owed
listing.description:
Run the royalty side of an author-publisher business in one Excel workbook. Built for an independent author who sells through several stores, in several currencies and countries, and wants to know what was earned, what was paid and what is still owed.

The Sales ledger and the monthly totals by store and by format give your royalties in one home currency, with the rate of each month. Royalty per copy by edition sets the actual royalty against the plan from price, store share and the cost of a copy. Statements and Payments received show the expected date of every store with your own payment delay, the oldest unpaid month, the days overdue and the short amount that fees do not explain. Fee and exchange check flags payments above your own limit. Page reads keep the page-read income line as an estimate that moves every month.

18 tools answer the questions an author asks every week: did this store pay what it earned, which store to write to first, which payments came in short, what lands in the bank over the next 4 months, what happens if you lose the largest store, how much the page-read rate matters, and what the next 3 months may bring from your own history. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to your assistant, your accountant and yourself.

A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros, no login and no subscription, with a sample copy full of demo data and a blank copy for your own numbers. It helps you keep track of your income and does not promise sales or results. Check each store's current terms and confirm tax questions with your adviser.
features: Earned against paid for every store
Oldest unpaid month and overdue ranking
Short-payment finder with the amount to claim
Fees and exchange loss check per payment
Royalty per copy by edition and store
Page-read income as a clear estimate
Dashboard with 30 live figures and 22 charts
No macros, works in Excel and Google Sheets
